name: Precarious Pile
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Little Trouble in Big Absalom
description: This dangerously unsteady pile of miscellaneous goods stands 7 feet high and 10 feet wide
disable:
DC 15 Thievery check to carefully excavate a path through the wall without upsetting its balance

DC 17 Athletics check to hold up any unstable portions

offensiveAbilities.name: Collapse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to climb or remove an object from the wall or the wall suffers a forceful impact

Effect The wall collapses, dealing 2d8 bludgeoning damage to creatures on it or within 10 feet of it. A creature that succeeds at a DC 18 Reflex save takes half damage and rolls out of the way in a random direction. On a critical success, they take no damage and can choose the direction.
